content.value_statement: Growing Plans.md and session logs make project context hard to scan. This skill guides cleanup checks, archive decisions, and safe maintenance summaries.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when Plans.md exceeds configured line thresholds.
Counts completed tasks marked as confirmed in Plans.md.
Detects completed tasks older than seven days using date markers.
Checks session-log.md length and recommends monthly archive files.
Warns when CLAUDE.md is large and suggests splitting reference material.
Provides cleanup output formats for normal, recommended, and completed states.
limitations: Does not provide a complete standalone cleanup script.
Targets Plans.md, session-log.md, and CLAUDE.md rather than arbitrary files.
Requires careful review before moving or editing project files.
Thresholds depend on configuration values or documented defaults.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Project Handoff
use_cases.description: Review Plans.md and session logs before sharing context with another collaborator.

use_cases.title: Clean Completed Task Lists
use_cases.description: Find old completed tasks and move them into an archive after review.

use_cases.title: Control Context File Growth
use_cases.description: Check CLAUDE.md and session logs for size problems before they slow daily work.

prompt_templates.title: Check Cleanup Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple status review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my project maintenance files and tell me whether cleanup is needed. Do not edit files yet.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Archive Candidates
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to find old completed tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect Plans.md for completed tasks older than seven days. Show archive candidates and ask before moving anything.

prompt_templates.title: Review Session Log Size
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to control session-log growth.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check .claude/memory/session-log.md for size issues. Recommend a monthly archive plan without changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Run Controlled Maintenance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a reviewed cleanup workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a dry-run maintenance review for Plans.md, session-log.md, and CLAUDE.md. Include proposed edits, backups, and approval checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Clean up files before ending the session.
output: Plans.md is above the documented threshold.
Eight completed tasks appear ready for archive review.
No files were changed because approval is still needed.
CLAUDE.md is longer than the recommended size.
Move rarely used reference material into separate docs.
Keep only always-needed instructions in the main file.
The session log is within the documented limit.
No archive action is recommended now.
Run the check again after major project sessions.

best_practices: Run a dry-run review before any file movement.
Confirm archive targets and backup names before edits.
Keep active work separate from completed task archives.
anti_patterns: Do not move tasks marked as in progress or awaiting review.
Do not run cleanup without checking proposed changes first.
Do not use the skill for feature implementation or code review.

faq.question: What files does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Plans.md, .claude/memory/session-log.md, and CLAUDE.md maintenance checks.

faq.question: Does it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: It should preview cleanup actions and ask for approval before edits.

faq.question: Can thresholds be customized?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation describes values in .claude-code-harness.config.yaml.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written for AI-assisted project maintenance in those tools.

faq.question: Does it archive active tasks?
faq.answer: No. The guidance excludes active and awaiting-review tasks from archive movement.

faq.question: What should I review before approving cleanup?
faq.answer: Review the candidate tasks, target archive path, backup name, and exact file changes.
